summary: Learn Revit MEP system routing, model checks and documentation through practical exercises. Explore the 10-day foundation course.
lede: Revit MEP training develops foundation-level skills for building-services professionals who model and document mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems. Technicians, designers and engineers practise placing components, routing ducts and pipes, and creating electrical circuits. They also check connectors and system properties, work with spaces and zones, and prepare annotated views, schedules and sheets for model review.
audienceIntro: This course suits foundation-level building-services professionals who need to create, review or document mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems in Revit. It is designed for practitioners developing reliable model and coordination workflows.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with mechanical, electrical or plumbing building-services layouts is helpful. No prior Revit experience is assumed. Coding or programming is not required. For hands-on Revit exercises, you will need access to Autodesk Revit; confirm software availability and licensing before attending.
